author: Ariadne I
title: RC-DiagLDS + Horizon-Weighted MAE (HMAE) + GradClip
abstract: Keeps RC-DiagLDS architecture but trains with a horizon-weighted MAE that linearly emphasizes later steps (normalized to mean=1) to improve long-horizon accuracy, plus global-norm gradient clipping for stability. Retains residual copy head and column-normalized loadings; k=48, H=64.
